comment: ANCHOR: ENTRY_PLANNER_LIVE_PRICE_20261107 — the entry planner prices a plan from a live quote (Finviz cache, else a fresh broker quote <= 30 min) and never from the bars' last close (LQ-20261107-04): no qualifying quote means no plan, and the price's source and stamp travel into the stored plan.
